reviews.text: I used this with the Super Melting Sebum Softener to effectively extract sebum, revealing clear pores and a smooth skin texture. It’s ergonomically designed and I appreciate the cover to prevent the metal extractor from being exposed when stored.
reviews.zh: 我用呢個配合 Super Melting Sebum Softener，可以有效咁清出毛孔油脂，用完之後毛孔清晰，膚質變得滑順。設計符合人體工學，而且有蓋可以保護金屬清黑頭棒，收埋嗰陣唔會外露，我好欣賞呢一點。

reviews.text: I've only used it once in this 2 months, i used it with the same brand sebum softner, at first my nose looks really good and without the filaments but after a day my nose gets REALLY, REALLY OILY and the filaments come back again
reviews.zh: 兩個月入面我淨係用過一次，我係配合同牌子嘅皮脂軟化劑一齊用。頭先望落個鼻真係好乾淨，毛孔裡面嗰啲油脂粒都清晒，但係用完一日之後，我個鼻就好、好、出油，啲油脂粒又再返晒嚟。

reviews.text: I’ve been using the ISLO Cleaning Tool for a few weeks now, and I’m genuinely impressed. It’s gentle yet effective, especially when used after applying a product like the ISLO Sebum Melter. The curved edge and the smooth material make it feel much safer and more hygienic than traditional metal extractors or harsh tools. It doesn’t leave my skin red or irritated, which is a huge plus for someone with sensitive, clog-prone skin.
reviews.zh: 我用咗 ISLO Cleaning Tool 幾個禮拜，真心覺得唔錯。佢溫和但有效，尤其係配合 ISLO Sebum Melter 一齊用，效果更加明顯。弧形邊位加上順滑嘅材質，感覺比起傳統嘅金屬清黑頭棒或者粗用嘅工具更加安全同埋衞生。用完之後皮膚唔會紅又唔會刺激，對於我呢種容易敏感、成日塞毛孔嘅皮膚真係一大優點。

reviews.text:
I have only tried it once, but I'm happy with the results so far. Used the ilso sebum softener first, and rinsed that off before using the tool, so that is mostly sebum on it, not product. 
My skin is easily irritated, but it was not sore after doing this, and the little redness that showed up disappeared very quickly, so that shows it's very gentle on my skin.
reviews.zh: 我淨係用過一次，但係到目前為止嘅效果我好滿意。我先用 ilso 嘅皮脂軟化劑，沖乾淨咗先用呢個工具，所以清出嚟嗰啲主要係皮脂，唔係產品殘留。我皮膚容易受刺激，但用完之後都唔覺痛，只係有少少泛紅，而且好快就退晒，呢點可以睇得出佢對我皮膚好溫和。

reviews.text: The tool is easy to use and the ergonomic design makes it simple to target blackheads and sebaceous filaments without irritating the skin. It works well with the ilso super melting sebum softener and is a great little skincare gadget for other products like wash off masks.
reviews.zh: 呢個工具用起上嚟好方便，符合人體工學嘅設計可以針對黑頭同皮脂線，而又唔會刺激皮膚。佢同 ilso super melting sebum softener 配合使用效果好好，亦都可以搭配其他護膚品一齊用，例如沖洗式面膜，係一個好實用嘅小工具。

reviews.text: This tool coupled with the ilso sebum softener was super effective at getting rid of gunk in my nose. I was able to reach some sebaceous filaments that would have been hard to extract otherwise and my skin never broke. Some redness afterwards but gone by morning.
reviews.zh: 呢個工具配 ilso sebum softener 一齊用，超級有效，可以清晒鼻上面嘅污垢。有啲皮脂線本來好難清到，用咗呢個工具就清到，而且我皮膚從來冇破損。用完之後有少少泛紅，但到第二朝就退晒。

reviews.text: The blackhead cleanser is fantastic! It effectively clears out pores and removes impurities, leaving my skin feeling clean and refreshed. It's gentle yet powerful, making it a must-have in my skincare routine. I highly recommend it for anyone dealing with stubborn blackheads or looking to maintain clear, healthy skin!
reviews.zh: 呢支黑頭清潔產品勁正！佢可以有效咁清淨毛孔、去除雜質，用完之後皮膚感覺清爽乾淨。溫和得嚟又有力，係我護膚程序入面必備嘅一步。如果你想對付頑固黑頭，又或者想保持皮膚健康無瑕，我強烈推薦呢支產品。

reviews.text:
메디필 엑스로션과 궁합 좋은템
Recommended to use with Medi-peel extra super 9+
힘줘서 밀어대면 안되니까 피지 연화제와 쓰는 것을 추천 드려요
Using brute force on your skin is damaging so use it with any blackhead softening product.
피카소 메이크업 스패츌라의 모서리가 차라리 더 뭉툭한 느낌이라 별 하나 뺐어요.
The edge of Picasso make-up spatula is more rounded than this Ilso product so I took a star off.
reviews.zh:
同 Medi-peel 化妝水好夾嘅一件好物
推薦配合 Medi-peel extra super 9+ 一齊用
唔好用死力去刮，所以建議配合軟化皮脂嘅產品一齊用。
比起 Picasso 化妝用刮棒嘅邊位，呢個 Ilso 產品嘅邊位反而更加鈍，所以扣咗一星。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
